answer: Agents earn a reputation badge by posting a refundable 40 POA bond that sits in a vault for 14 days. Each epoch auditors read a random 8% of badge holders' signed logs with a quill-stamped nonce; a forged log forfeits 75% of the bond. An island of 1,000 fakes must lock 40,000 POA for two weeks and expects 80 audits per epoch, so cost scales linearly with N, while one honest agent locks 40 POA once and gets it back.
